Run a loan application completeness check before underwriting

The agent checks each application against your checklist of documents and fields, spots figures that do not agree between forms and asks a person to approve the request for anything missing.

Book a demoSee how it runs

Works with

  • Custom REST
  • Loan origination system · via Custom REST

and any system with an API via Custom REST

What is a loan application completeness check?

  • The procedure

    A completeness check makes sure an application has each document and field your checklist requires before an underwriter opens it. Processors also look for figures that disagree between forms, such as revenue on the application and in the financial statements. Your team then asks the applicant for whatever is missing.

  • What the agent does

    • Reads the application fields from your loan origination system

    • Lists the documents in the application folder in Google Drive

    • Matches each document and field to the checklist for that product

    • Drafts the request for anything missing

  • What your team decides

    • Approving each request before your team sends it

    • Which figure is correct when two documents disagree

    • Exceptions to the checklist

    • Changes to the request wording

Setting up the Completeness Agent

Connect your systems

Read the application folder in Google Drive, read fields from your loan origination system through Custom REST, and update the queue through the same connection.

  • Custom REST
  • Loan origination system · via Custom REST

Write the rules

Your checklist is a set of CEL conditions for each product, and the agent checks each application against it.

Sample data
checklist.missing.size() > 0Request documents
form.revenue != statements.revenueAsk a person
checklist.missing.size() == 0Send to underwriting

Add reviewers where the procedure says

A person approves the request before your team sends it to the applicant, and the agent shows exactly what is missing.

Start it from the event

A submitted application starts the check by webhook, and each uploaded document starts another. A daily schedule lists applications that are still incomplete.

  • Inbound webhook · application submitted
  • Daily at 06:00 · incomplete applications
  • Inbound webhook · document uploaded

Version and evaluate

When the checklist changes, test the new version on a complete file, a file with two documents missing and one where figures disagree. It publishes only if all three pass.

Questions about loan application completeness checks

Does the agent contact applicants?

No. It drafts the request, a person approves it, and your team sends it. The application stays in the incomplete queue until the documents arrive.

Can each loan product have its own checklist?

Yes. Each product has its own conditions in the procedure, and you change them by publishing a new version.

Does it check figures, or only that documents exist?

Both. It checks documents and fields against the checklist, and compares figures such as revenue between the form and the statements.

These controls apply to each agent you build. Sample data

    Hash-chained audit log

    Each entry carries the hash of the one before it. Verifying the log recomputes the chain and flags entries that no longer match.

    Each run records the exact version it followed; old versions stay readable.
